title: COCO _ Sofa and Arm chair
description: Coco is a sofa inspired by angles and inclinations, which convey a sense of challenge, strength, and boldness. At the same time, its fluted upholstery creates a deliberate contrast, resulting in a sofa with daring angular lines that gently embrace the user through the backrest and side cushions. The soft and comfortable fluted cushioning introduces a rounded volume that softens the overall visual language.

The angular solid wood structure reflects a refined woodworking approach, where precision craftsmanship transforms a strong geometric form into a warm and domestic object. Coco is designed to create an initial moment of visual tension that resolves into comfort once the user sits down, turning a seemingly aggressive form into a welcoming and reassuring experience.
The concept of Coco is based on a tilted cube.

From a side view, the sofa appears to lean forward, suggesting that the user might tip or fall when sitting. However, both the seat and backrest are designed with standard ergonomic angles, ensuring a comfortable and safe seating experience suitable for a domestic environment.
